name: Dwarf
traits: Medium. Speed 5 squares and low-light vision. Constitution +2 and Wisdom +2. Speak Common and Dwarven. Gain +2 to Dungeoneering and Endurance.
Cast-Iron Stomach gives +5 to saving throws against poison. Dwarven Resilience makes Second Wind a minor action.
Dwarven Weapon Proficiency grants proficiency with throwing hammers and warhammers. Encumbered Speed prevents armor or a heavy load from reducing speed. Other movement restrictions apply normally.
Stand Your Ground lets you reduce a forced pull, push or slide by 1 square. When an attack would knock you prone, you can make an immediate saving throw to stay upright.

name: Eladrin
traits: Medium. Speed 6 squares and low-light vision. Dexterity +2 and Intelligence +2. Speak Common and Elven. Gain +2 to Arcana and History.
Eladrin Education trains one additional skill of your choice. Eladrin Weapon Proficiency grants longsword proficiency.
Eladrin Will adds +1 to Will defense and +5 to saves against charm. Fey Origin makes effects concerning creature origin treat you as fey.
Trance gives the benefits of a six-hour extended rest in four hours while you remain aware. Fey Step is an encounter move action that teleports you up to 5 squares.

name: Elf
traits: Medium. Speed 7 squares and low-light vision. Dexterity +2 and Wisdom +2. Speak Common and Elven. Gain +2 to Nature and Perception.
Elven Weapon Proficiency grants longbow and shortbow proficiency. Fey Origin makes effects concerning creature origin treat you as fey.
Group Awareness gives non-elf allies within 5 squares +1 to Perception. Wild Step ignores difficult terrain during a shift.
Elven Accuracy is an encounter free action that rerolls one attack. The second roll replaces the first.

name: Half-Elf
traits: Medium. Speed 6 squares and low-light vision. Constitution +2 and Charisma +2. Speak Common, Elven and one other language. Gain +2 to Diplomacy and Insight.
Dilettante grants one at-will power from another class at level 1 and allows its use once per encounter.
Dual Heritage qualifies you for elf and human feats when you meet their other prerequisites. Group Diplomacy grants allies within 10 squares +1 to Diplomacy.

name: Halfling
traits: Small. Speed 6 squares and normal vision. Dexterity +2 and Charisma +2. Speak Common and one other language. Gain +2 to Acrobatics and Thievery.
Bold gives +5 to saves against fear. Nimble Reaction gives +2 AC against opportunity attacks.
Second Chance is an encounter immediate interrupt when an enemy hits you. Force the enemy to reroll the attack and retain the second result.

Apply the first-printing Small weapon rules. A Small character uses versatile weapons in two hands without the extra damage and can use two-handed weapons with the small property. The small property also removes the versatile restriction.
